subject: Detach dead soldiers from reciprocal combat-neighbour lines
description: On production baseline `2338dc115`, old schema-12 representative `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_nicouzouf/Profile_001/Savegame_039/replay-007-session-0001.jsonl.zst` first diverged after frame 406 on Soldier90's movement goal and normalized increment. Rust targeted `(781.6382,2047.5701)`, the exact midpoint of live Soldier81 and dead cached right neighbour Soldier91, while Original targeted `(790.9166,2052.7266)`, the exact midpoint of Soldier81 and live Soldier54. Both engines had formed the Soldier90-Soldier91-Soldier54 line before Soldier91 died. Original's virtual `RHArtificialMalignity::SetState(SLEEPING_FOREVER)` leaves every combat-line mode and synchronously calls `UpdateLeftCombatNeighbour(NULL)` and `UpdateRightCombatNeighbour(NULL)`; those methods clear both the dead soldier's pointers and the neighbours' reciprocal halves (`original-code/RHartificialmalignity.cpp:9359-9365`; `original-code/RHelementactorsoldier.cpp:2337-2389`). Rust's lethal path instead assigned `SleepingForever` directly after `detach_npc_death_relationships`, whose purported SetState emulation covered guarded-PC and archery relationships but omitted combat neighbours. Commit `37fea7ac444d6651dbca7d3544504d4e6aff2aba` extends that synchronous death boundary to clear current left/right links and recover zero-valued reciprocal `SetLeftCombatNeighbour`/`SetRightCombatNeighbour` actions already queued by `EnemyAi::set_state` before `clear_all_pending`; targets are deduplicated, and any nonzero missing/non-soldier/non-Enemy neighbour fails loudly. The three `soldier_death_` regressions pass: live three-soldier topology, locals-already-zero queued reciprocal teardown, and the pre-existing guarded-PC/archery cleanup. An optimized runner built from isolated baseline `2338dc115` plus the exact patch clears the former frame-406 Soldier90 goal/increment boundary and advances 429 frames to an independent `sprite.rs` index panic while replaying Original frame 835 to 836. Distinct control `Savegame_nicouzouf/Profile_001/Savegame_045/replay-010-session-0001.jsonl.zst` remains exact EOF across all 1,500 recorded frames. No current-HEAD clearance is claimed: the later committed integration lineage independently diverges earlier after frame 143 on Soldier110's direction/direction-goal/sprite-row, so it cannot yet exercise Lane36's death boundary.
